reviewRationale: The position is approved for a hidden convert-material-advantage technical pilot. The approved first move is cxd5, followed by the authored deterministic route 1...Ke7 2.Kc4 Kd6 3.Kd4 Kc7. Success is not awarded merely for capturing the pawn. It requires the exact authored terminal, the white king on d4, both white pawns still present, the black d5 pawn removed by the white c-pawn, and the verified win preserved. The alternative exd5 preserves the theoretical result but misses the approved conversion mechanism, so it must be classified as objective-miss-result-preserved and never as chess-result-failure. Other covered moves that preserve the win but leave the authored route are truthful authored-concept misses or accepted alternatives according to the approved graph. A move is chess-result-failure only when exact evidence changes the win to a draw or loss. Promotion is outside this bounded exercise and is not required for success. Stalemate is never success. Repetition, uncovered states, digest failures, invalid artifacts, missing transitions, ambiguous classifications, and internal errors are neutral technical-unavailable conditions. The maximum length is eight plies. The third-stage move reveal removes independent-success eligibility. No result may create scoring, Personal Best, leaderboard data, Training Memory, Mastery, Recommendations, account data, analytics, telemetry, or persistent browser storage. This approval is bound to the reviewed position, graph, engine evidence, and packet digests. Any change requires a new human-review revision.
